summary.text: COPAUA0C is the CICS card-authorization decision program (transaction id literal 'CP00') started by an MQ trigger: it RETRIEVEs the trigger message (MQTM) to get the request queue name, opens it and loops MQGET (5-second wait) until no message is available or more than 500 requests have been processed. Each request is a comma-delimited string unstrung into PENDING-AUTH-REQUEST (CCPAURQY). For each request it schedules IMS PSB PSBPAUTB, reads the card cross-reference (CCXREF), account (ACCTDAT) and customer (CUSTDAT) VSAM files and the IMS pending authorization summary (PAUTSUM0) for the account. It approves the request when the transaction amount does not exceed the available credit (credit limit minus balance, taken from the IMS summary when it exists, otherwise from the account master) and declines otherwise with response '05' and a reason code. The comma-delimited response (CCPAURLY) is sent with MQPUT1 to the request's reply-to queue with the saved correlation id. When the card was found, the summary segment is updated or inserted and a PAUTDTL1 detail segment is inserted; a CICS SYNCPOINT follows each message. Errors are written to TD queue CSSL using the CCPAUERY layout and critical errors terminate the task.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.logic: Performs 1000-INITIALIZE, 2000-MAIN-PROCESS and 9000-TERMINATE in sequence, then issues EXEC CICS RETURN.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.logic: RETRIEVEs the MQ trigger message into MQTM (NOHANDLE); on NORMAL saves MQTM-QNAME as WS-REQUEST-QNAME and MQTM-TRIGGERDATA. Sets the MQGET wait interval to 5000 ms, opens the request queue and reads the first request message.

paragraphs.name: 1000-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 1000-INITIALIZE (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 1100-OPEN-REQUEST-QUEUE
paragraphs.logic: Calls MQOPEN on WS-REQUEST-QNAME with MQOO-INPUT-SHARED. On MQCC-OK sets WS-REQUEST-MQ-OPEN; otherwise logs a critical MQ error at location 'M001' with message 'REQ MQ OPEN ERROR', which ends the task.

paragraphs.name: 1100-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 1100-OPEN-REQUEST-QUEUE (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 1200-SCHEDULE-PSB
paragraphs.logic: Schedules PSB PSB-NAME ('PSBPAUTB') with DLI SCHD NODHABEND. If status 'TC' (already scheduled) it issues DLI TERM and schedules again. Status OK sets IMS-PSB-SCHD; otherwise logs critical IMS error 'I001' 'IMS SCHD FAILED' and ends the task.

paragraphs.name: 1200-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 1200-SCHEDULE-PSB (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 2000-MAIN-PROCESS
paragraphs.logic: Loops until NO-MORE-MSG-AVAILABLE or WS-LOOP-END: extracts the request, processes the authorization, adds 1 to WS-MSG-PROCESSED, issues CICS SYNCPOINT and marks the PSB as not scheduled. When WS-MSG-PROCESSED exceeds WS-REQSTS-PROCESS-LIMIT (500) it sets WS-LOOP-END, otherwise reads the next request message.

paragraphs.name: 2000-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 2000-MAIN-PROCESS (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 2100-EXTRACT-REQUEST-MSG
paragraphs.logic: UNSTRINGs W01-GET-BUFFER(1:W01-DATALEN) delimited by ',' into the 18 PA-RQ- request fields (amount into WS-TRANSACTION-AMT-AN). Converts the amount with FUNCTION NUMVAL into PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT and copies it to WS-TRANSACTION-AMT.

paragraphs.name: 2100-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 2100-EXTRACT-REQUEST-MSG (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ
paragraphs.logic: MQGETs the next message (no syncpoint, wait WS-WAIT-INTERVAL, convert, fail-if-quiescing) into the 500-byte W01-GET-BUFFER. On success saves the correlation id and reply-to queue name; reason MQRC-NO-MSG-AVAILABLE sets NO-MORE-MSG-AVAILABLE; any other failure logs critical error 'M003' 'FAILED TO READ REQUEST MQ' and ends the task.

paragraphs.name: 3100-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 5000-PROCESS-AUTH
paragraphs.logic: Defaults the decision to APPROVE-AUTH, schedules the PSB and presets card/account found flags. Reads the card xref; only when the card is found does it read account, customer, IMS auth summary and (empty) profile data. Always makes the decision and sends the response; writes the authorization to IMS only when the card was found in the xref.

paragraphs.name: 5000-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 5000-PROCESS-AUTH (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 5100-READ-XREF-RECORD
paragraphs.logic: Reads CCXREF by PA-RQ-CARD-NUM into CARD-XREF-RECORD. NORMAL sets CARD-FOUND-XREF; NOTFND sets CARD-NFOUND-XREF and NFOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR and logs warning 'A001' 'CARD NOT FOUND IN XREF'; other responses log critical CICS error 'C001' and end the task.

paragraphs.name: 5100-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 5100-READ-XREF-RECORD (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 5200-READ-ACCT-RECORD
paragraphs.logic: Reads ACCTDAT by XREF-ACCT-ID into ACCOUNT-RECORD. NORMAL sets FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR; NOTFND sets NFOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR and logs warning 'A002' (message text says 'ACCT NOT FOUND IN XREF'); other responses log critical error 'C002' and end the task.

paragraphs.name: 5200-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 5200-READ-ACCT-RECORD (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 5300-READ-CUST-RECORD
paragraphs.logic: Reads CUSTDAT by XREF-CUST-ID into CUSTOMER-RECORD. NORMAL sets FOUND-CUST-IN-MSTR; NOTFND sets NFOUND-CUST-IN-MSTR and logs warning 'A003' 'CUST NOT FOUND IN XREF'; other responses log critical error 'C003' and end the task.

paragraphs.name: 5300-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 5300-READ-CUST-RECORD (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 5500-READ-AUTH-SUMMRY
paragraphs.logic: Issues DLI GU for PAUTSUM0 WHERE ACCNTID = XREF-ACCT-ID into PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY. Status OK sets FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG, 'GE' sets NFOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG, other statuses log critical IMS error 'I002' 'IMS GET SUMMARY FAILED' and end the task.

paragraphs.name: 5500-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 5500-READ-AUTH-SUMMRY (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 5600-READ-PROFILE-DATA
paragraphs.logic: Placeholder paragraph containing only CONTINUE; no profile data is read.

paragraphs.name: 5600-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 5600-READ-PROFILE-DATA (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 6000-MAKE-DECISION
paragraphs.logic: Copies card number, transaction id and request auth time (as auth id code) to the response. Computes available credit from the IMS summary (PA-CREDIT-LIMIT - PA-CREDIT-BALANCE) or, if no summary, from the account (ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT - ACCT-CURR-BAL) and declines with INSUFFICIENT-FUND when the amount exceeds it; declines when neither exists. Sets response code '00' with approved amount = request amount or '05' with 0, maps decline flags to reason codes 3100/4100/4200/4300/5100/5200/9000 (default '0000'), and STRINGs the comma-delimited reply into W02-PUT-BUFFER.

paragraphs.name: 6000-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 6000-MAKE-DECISION (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 7100-SEND-RESPONSE
paragraphs.logic: Builds a reply MQMD (MQMT-REPLY, saved correlation id, not persistent, expiry 50, string format) and MQPUT1s W02-PUT-BUFFER (length WS-RESP-LENGTH) to WS-REPLY-QNAME without syncpoint. A non-OK completion logs critical MQ error 'M004' 'FAILED TO PUT ON REPLY MQ' and ends the task.

paragraphs.name: 7100-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 7100-SEND-RESPONSE (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 8000-WRITE-AUTH-TO-DB
paragraphs.logic: Performs 8400-UPDATE-SUMMARY then 8500-INSERT-AUTH.

paragraphs.name: 8000-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 8000-WRITE-AUTH-TO-DB (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 8400-UPDATE-SUMMARY
paragraphs.logic: When no summary exists it initializes PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY to zeros with account and customer id from the xref. Refreshes credit and cash limits from the account record; on approval adds 1 to PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT, adds the approved amount to PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT and PA-CREDIT-BALANCE and zeroes PA-CASH-BALANCE; on decline adds 1 to PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT and PA-TRANSACTION-AMT to PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT. Then REPLs the existing summary or ISRTs a new one; a non-OK status logs critical 'I003' and ends the task.

paragraphs.name: 8400-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 8400-UPDATE-SUMMARY (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 8500-INSERT-AUTH
paragraphs.logic: Gets the current CICS time (YYDDD, HHMMSS, milliseconds) and builds the descending key PA-AUTH-DATE-9C = 99999 - YYDDD and PA-AUTH-TIME-9C = 999999999 - time-with-ms. Copies request and response fields into PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS, sets PA-MATCH-PENDING for approvals or PA-MATCH-AUTH-DECLINED for declines, blanks the fraud fields and ISRTs PAUTDTL1 under the account's PAUTSUM0. A non-OK status logs critical 'I004' 'IMS INSERT DETL FAILED' and ends the task.

paragraphs.name: 8500-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 8500-INSERT-AUTH (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 9000-TERMINATE
paragraphs.logic: Issues DLI TERM when IMS-PSB-SCHD is set, then closes the request queue.

paragraphs.name: 9000-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 9000-TERMINATE (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 9100-CLOSE-REQUEST-QUEUE
paragraphs.logic: When WS-REQUEST-MQ-OPEN, calls MQCLOSE; success sets WS-REQUEST-MQ-CLSE, failure logs warning 'M005' 'FAILED TO CLOSE REQUEST MQ'.

paragraphs.name: 9100-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 9100-CLOSE-REQUEST-QUEUE (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 9500-LOG-ERROR
paragraphs.logic: Stamps ERROR-LOG-RECORD with transaction id 'CP00', program name and current YYMMDD/time, and writes it to TD queue 'CSSL' (NOHANDLE). When ERR-CRITICAL is set it performs 9990-END-ROUTINE.

paragraphs.name: 9500-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 9500-LOG-ERROR (EXIT only).

paragraphs.name: 9990-END-ROUTINE
paragraphs.logic: Performs 9000-TERMINATE (DLI TERM, close queue) and issues EXEC CICS RETURN, ending the task.

paragraphs.name: 9990-EXIT
paragraphs.logic: Exit point of 9990-END-ROUTINE (EXIT only, not reached).

rules.statement: A triggered COPAUA0C task processes request messages until the queue is empty (5-second MQGET wait) or until more than 500 requests (WS-REQSTS-PROCESS-LIMIT) have been processed, committing with CICS SYNCPOINT after each request.
rules.outcome: Loop ends; task terminates (DLI TERM, MQCLOSE, CICS RETURN). Remaining messages wait for a new trigger.

rules.statement: Account, customer and IMS summary data are looked up only when the card number is found in the card cross-reference file; the authorization is written to the IMS database (summary update and detail insert) only for cards found in the cross-reference. A response is always returned.
rules.conditions: CARD-FOUND-XREF after CCXREF read by PA-RQ-CARD-NUM
rules.outcome: Card not found: decision runs (declined) and response sent, but no IMS write.

rules.statement: Available credit is the IMS summary credit limit minus the summary credit balance when a pending-authorization summary exists for the account; otherwise it is the account master credit limit minus current balance. The request is declined for insufficient funds when the transaction amount is greater than the available credit, and declined (no reason flag) when neither summary nor account record exists.
rules.conditions: FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG -> PA-CREDIT-LIMIT - PA-CREDIT-BALANCE; else FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR -> ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT - ACCT-CURR-BAL; else decline
rules.outcome: DECLINE-AUTH and INSUFFICIENT-FUND set when amount exceeds available; DECLINE-AUTH alone when no account data.

rules.statement: A declined authorization returns response code '05' with approved amount 0; an approved authorization returns response code '00' with the approved amount equal to the full requested transaction amount (no partial approvals).
rules.outcome: PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-CODE '05'/'00'; PA-RL-APPROVED-AMT and WS-APPROVED-AMT 0 or PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT.

rules.statement: Decline reason codes: card, account or customer not found = '3100'; insufficient funds = '4100'; card not active = '4200'; account closed = '4300'; card fraud = '5100'; merchant fraud = '5200'; any other decline = '9000'. Approved responses carry reason '0000'.
rules.conditions: AUTH-RESP-DECLINED, first true of the decline flags in EVALUATE order
rules.outcome: PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON set; also stored as PA-AUTH-RESP-REASON in the detail segment.

rules.statement: When writing an authorization, the account's pending summary is created if absent (zeros, account and customer id from xref), its credit and cash limits are refreshed from the account master, and its totals are updated: approved -> approved count +1, approved amount and credit balance + approved amount, cash balance set to 0; declined -> declined count +1 and declined amount + PA-TRANSACTION-AMT. The summary is then replaced or inserted.
rules.conditions: Card found in xref; NFOUND/FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG; AUTH-RESP-APPROVED
rules.outcome: DLI REPL or ISRT of PAUTSUM0.

rules.statement: Each authorization detail is keyed by complemented date and time (PA-AUTH-DATE-9C = 99999 - current YYDDD, PA-AUTH-TIME-9C = 999999999 - HHMMSSmmm) so that the newest authorization sorts first, and its match status starts as 'P' (pending) when approved or 'D' (declined) when declined, with fraud fields blank.
rules.conditions: Card found in xref (detail insert path)
rules.outcome: PAUTDTL1 inserted under PAUTSUM0 for XREF-ACCT-ID.

rules.statement: Every error is logged to TD queue CSSL; errors classified critical (MQ open/get/put failures, unexpected VSAM responses, IMS schedule/read/update/insert failures) terminate the task immediately (DLI TERM, MQCLOSE, CICS RETURN), while not-found conditions and MQ close failures are warnings that let processing continue.
rules.outcome: 9990-END-ROUTINE: terminate and CICS RETURN; no explicit rollback is issued.
messages: FAILED TO PUT ON REPLY MQ

no_rule_decisions.reason: Technical IMS PSB re-schedule when already scheduled ('TC').
Technical: terminate PSB only if scheduled.
Technical: close request queue only if open; failure is a warning.

observations.text: Declined-amount accumulation adds PA-TRANSACTION-AMT, a detail-segment field that is only populated later in 8500-INSERT-AUTH (line 884); at this point it holds the previous request's value (or whatever the last IMS read left), not the current request amount.

WS-RESP-LENGTH (STRING pointer, initial VALUE 1) is never reset between messages, so the second and later replies are appended after the first in the 200-byte W02-PUT-BUFFER and W02-BUFFLEN grows; once full, STRING overflows and replies become wrong. The pointer value is also one past the last character, so the sent length includes an extra byte.

CARD-NOT-ACTIVE, ACCOUNT-CLOSED, CARD-FRAUD and MERCHANT-FRAUD are never set anywhere in the program, so reason codes 4200, 4300, 5100 and 5200 cannot be produced; 5600-READ-PROFILE-DATA is an empty placeholder.

WS-DECLINE-REASON-FLG and WS-CUST-MASTER-READ-FLG are not reset per message; a stale INSUFFICIENT-FUND or NFOUND-CUST-IN-MSTR from a previous request can influence the reason code of a later decline. Customer-not-found alone does not cause a decline.
8400-UPDATE-SUMMARY moves ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT/ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT into the summary even when the account read returned NOTFND, so stale account-record data from an earlier message may be written.

MQGET uses MQGMO-NO-SYNCPOINT, so a request is removed from the queue before it is processed; a task that ends on a critical error loses the message. The reply is also put outside syncpoint before the IMS write is committed.
Error message texts for account and customer master reads say 'NOT FOUND IN XREF'; the MQGET failure is tagged ERR-CICS instead of ERR-MQ.
Process limit 500, MQGET wait 5000 ms, reply expiry 50 (tenths of a second), TD queue 'CSSL', transaction id 'CP00', PSB 'PSBPAUTB' and file names are hard-coded.
The response auth id code is the request's auth time (PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME), not a generated approval code.
Approval sets PA-CASH-BALANCE to 0 on every approved authorization, discarding any cash balance.

sme_questions.question: Should declined amount accumulate the current request amount (PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT / WS-TRANSACTION-AMT) instead of PA-TRANSACTION-AMT?
Where are card-active, account-closed and fraud checks expected to be implemented (reason codes 4200/4300/5100/5200)?
Is resetting PA-CASH-BALANCE to 0 on each approval intended?
Should a missing customer record cause a decline (it currently only affects the reason code)?
